card.title: IPhone 11 Not Powering on, 2A or Higher Power Draw After Prompt to Boot

source.title: IPhone 11 Not Powering on, 2A or Higher Power Draw After Prompt to Boot

claims.statement: iPhone 11 drawing 2 A+: likely shorted cap on PP_VDD_MAIN or PP_VDD_BOOST; also a cracked U_NFC shorting in the bottom board, or rarely Rigel U4400.
Split the sandwich and power the top board alone to see whether the short is on the top or bottom board.
Yangtze heats instantly when injecting through the battery connector; usually a cap is the real short, rarely Yangtze itself.

procedure: Split; test top board alone for the short.
Inject 4 V / 2 A into the shorted board; remove hot cap.
Check U_NFC and Rigel U4400; check under Yangtze if suspected.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
